evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistent fatigue in the setting of a strong family
history of early heart disease.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 91 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 189 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 444 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.
Most recent echo showed an ejection fraction of 55%.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
30%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Severely reduced left ventricular systolic function.
